description: The mast's user name. With head it keys the row, and the same mast and head must be a wired head in wiring.csv and a row of lcos_signal_plan_notes.csv, or build_lcos_signal_manager_plan.py stops.
The head of the mast, as wiring.csv's disc_role gives it (S for a single head).
The Signal Manager's aligned condition, copied to the plan's Turnout polarity: Main (the turnout Normal, closed), Diverged (Reverse, thrown), or — for a head with no plant turnout.
The aspect the head shows when not aligned, copied to the plan's OR aspect: Stop, or Approach (the balloon intermediates).
Text for people. The build does not read it.
